description: Arc Image Dataset for Power Grid Fault Detection (PG-ArcSet) is a data set described in the paper "Arc Image Dataset for Power Grid Fault Detection (PG-ArcSet)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Zhenhao Wang, Jialong Wang, Xuhui Du and colleagues. With the expanding adoption of deep learning in power system monitoring, automated fault diagnosis based on arc image analysis has attracted significant research interest. However, the absence of standardized, well-annotated arc image datasets has hindered the development and fair evaluation of related recognition algorithms. To address this gap, we introduce a high-voltage arc image dataset comprising three fundamental arc types. Coverage: annotated arc images. The data are held on IEEE DataPort, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support power grid fault diagnosis from arc images. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
